title: 4 Bodies Found, 6 Climbers Missing After Avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan
summary_full: The body of Nadhira Alharthy, the first Omani woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest, was among those recovered. The influential British-Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja was missing.
